offset_convention_notes.python3_str: Offsets are Python 3 str indices: Unicode code points, half-open [start, end). paragraph[start:end] == unit text.
offset_convention_notes.utf8_bytes: UTF-8 byte offsets are not used. 'é' is 1 Python index and 2 UTF-8 bytes; mixing them would shift every later unit.
offset_convention_notes.utf16_code_units: UTF-16 code-unit offsets are not used. Supplementary-plane characters such as '😀' are 1 Python index and 2 UTF-16 code units.
